answer: Commit-reveal admission bound to a future beacon. A candidate posts a 0.50-unit escrow plus a cipher commitment before the epoch closes; the beacon value revealed at dawn samples 2 percent of commitments into the worker pool. Selection is unknowable at registration, so an attacker cannot aim a pulse of bought identities at favorable slots. Cost math: N=100 identities lock 50 units for 12 epochs; expected income is 0.02 x 100 x 0.10 = 0.20 units per epoch, or 2.4 over the lock, far below the 50 escrowed, forfeited when two commitments reuse one key.
